children: Industrial production in Russia declined 0.6% year-on-year in August 2026, reversing a 0.4% increase in July and contrasting with market expectations of a 0.5% gain.

Activity remained in contraction in mining, although the decline eased to 1.3% from 2.6%, while output in electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply fell 1.2%, following a 4% decline in the previous month.
Manufacturing output also contracted by 0.5%, reversing a 2.4% increase in July.
Meanwhile, production growth in water supply, sewerage, waste management and remediation accelerated to 6.9% from 2.8%.
On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial production declined 0.3%, reversing a 0.1% increase in July.

title: Russia Industrial Production Unexpectadly Declines
